violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit taken out of service to be washed and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (kitchen), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The (ceilings and walls ) in the (kitchen) area is in poor repair. Observed water stains and holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2026
The lighting in the 2 dr reach in was in poor repair. Observed low intensity and/or not working. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The plumbing to the (bar) handsink is in poor repair. Leak observed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2023

The presence of flies are not controlled as evidenced by live activity. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2023
The non-food contact surfaces of the (bar) refrigeration have an accumulation of water and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2023
The establishment is lacking hot water. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2023

The walls in the bar area and ceiling in the storage room are in poor repair. Inspector observed loose FRP, exposed wood and missing ceiling tile. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2023
